kind: Parser migration diagnostics; no Qwen inference or scientific-summary quality judgments
acceptance_criteria: Every returned page has matching provenance and valid layout spans
All extracted substantive words survive chunking in order; repeated table headers allowed
Native multi-column reading order and synthetic table row/cell associations pass software tests
Recognized bibliography boundaries exclude references and allow later supplements

historical_baseline.note: Earlier low-level parser report; differences in word/chunk counts are not quality scores.

observed_limitations: The real page-8 Transformer table still has split BLEU and training-cost header cells in native Markdown.
Merged and multi-row table headings and mathematical layout require source review; the adapter does not infer corrected values.
Word coverage checks the extracted representation, not recovery of every PDF element.
Timing includes per-process parser initialization; these single runs are not comparative performance benchmarks.
No OCR, vision interpretation, Qwen summary quality or joint memory evaluation was executed.
